recipe: 1. Stretch bar_frame horizontally with its 9-slice margins (see nine_slice.json).
2. The channel is the dark inner rounded rectangle: channel = [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the unstretched file; x1 moves right by (new width - file width).

3. Scale an outline-free fill (bar_fill_red, bar_fill_lime or bar_fill_blue) to the channel height, then to channel width x percent (9-slice its left and right caps; scale the whole strip when it is narrower than its caps).
4. Clip the fill to the channel; round the right end of partial fills with radius = channel height / 2.
5. Draw the fill over the dark channel and under nothing else.
